2608.05063.title: Hardware Design and Security in the Era of Chiplets and LLMs
2608.05063.paper_summary: The semiconductor industry is undergoing a dual revolution: the shift toward heterogeneous 2.5D chiplet systems and the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows. While these paradigms offer unprecedented benefits in yield, modularity, design productivity, etc., they radically expand the hardware attack surface. This paper provides a unified analysis of these frontiers, ranging from attacks on chiplet systems (including hardware stacks for LLM acceleration) across architectural, logical, and physical levels, to various exploits against LLM-driven EDA pipelines. To secure chiplet systems, we review a powerful defense approach that leverages 2.5D split manufacturing and active interposers for physically isolated Root of Trust (RoT) architectures. To secure LLM-driven EDA pipelines, we first identify native threats and then review state-of-the-art defense techniques. Finally, we discuss how LLM systems can advance hardware security efforts for modern systems, including chiplets.
2608.05063.paper_summary_zh: 半導體產業正經歷雙重革命：向異質2.5D晶片系統的轉變，以及將大型語言模型（LLMs）整合進電子設計自動化（EDA）流程中。雖然這些範式在產量、模組化、設計生產力等方面提供了前所未有的好處，但它們也徹底擴大了硬體攻擊面。本文提供了這些前沿的統一分析，涵蓋了對晶片系統的攻擊（包括針對LLM加速的硬體堆疊）在架構、邏輯和物理層面的各種攻擊，以及針對LLM驅動的EDA管道的各種利用。為了保護晶片系統，我們回顧了一種強大的防禦方法，該方法利用2.5D分割製造和主動介面器來實現物理隔離的信任根（RoT）架構。為了保護LLM驅動的EDA管道，我們首先識別原生威脅，然後回顧最先進的防禦技術。最後，我們討論了LLM系統如何推進現代系統的硬體安全工作，包括晶片。
